title.zh: 宣布马林杜克省 Boac 等三个市镇为旅游区的法案
title.en: An Act Declaring the Municipalities of Boac, Buenavista, and Torrijos in the Province of Marinduque as Tourist Zones
title.orig: An Act Declaring the Municipalities of Boac, Buenavista, and Torrijos in the Province of Marinduque as Tourist Zones

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1995/ra_8022_1995.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The municipalities of Boac, Buenavista, and Torrijos are hereby declared as tourist zones. As such, they shall be accorded priority development by the Department of Tourism and shall be subject to the rules and regulations governing the development of tourist zones.

The Department of Tourism, in coordination with the Philippine Tourism Authority and other concerned agencies of the government shall, within one (1) year from the approval of this Act, prepare a tourism development plan for the said municipalities of the Province of Marinduque which shall provide for the construction, improvement and/or maintenance of such appropriate facilities and infrastructure as shall enhance tourism in the areas stated in this Act: Provided, That said development plan shall ensure the preservation of the natural beauty and/or historical significance of the area.
The Department of Tourism shall take immediate steps to implement said development plan and shall incorporate the same in its overall tourism development program for the ensuing calendar year.
The Department of Tourism shall likewise promulgate the necessary rules and regulations for the proper implementation of this Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
